subject: Literature
title: Toni Morrison: An American Voice
description: Learn Toni Morrison: An American Voice in one minute.

hook.text: In 1993, Toni Morrison became the first African American woman to win the Nobel Prize in Literature.

buildup.text: Her novels like Beloved and Song of Solomon explored the trauma and beauty of the Black American experience.

discovery.text: Morrison centered Black lives in her fiction at a time when American literature largely marginalized them.

twist.text: Before becoming a novelist, she worked as an editor at Random House, championing other Black writers for years.

climax.text: Her Nobel recognized not just her novels but an entire tradition of Black storytelling she fought to elevate.

punchline.text: She opened the door and then held it for everyone behind her.

quiz.question: What did Morrison do before becoming a celebrated novelist?
options: She was a university professor of creative writing
She worked as an editor championing other Black writers
She was a journalist covering civil rights
